name: website-commander
description: Drive the Website Commander macOS app from VS Code: send the editor/selection to the agent, or pull a debug brief for the current site.

commands.title: Website Commander: Send selection to agent

websiteCommander.supportDir.markdownDescription: Override the app's support dir (where `bridge.token`/`bridge.port` live). Leave empty for the default `~/Library/Application Support/WebsiteCommander`.

websiteCommander.site.markdownDescription: Site name or `owner/repo` to target. Leave empty to use the app's active site (you'll be prompted if needed).
